sk_yen — 2D segmentation op

• Data kinds: image → region

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "sk_yen", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: binary_threshold (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

The type contract is image → region. For what it does in words, see the family usage guide and the runnable samples below (nothing is guessed here).
